FROM qc_inspection q JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = q.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = q.partner_id LEFT JOIN inv_doc d ON d.id = q.inv_doc_id LEFT JOIN prd_receipt r ON r.id = q.prd_receipt_id LEFT JOIN prd_order o ON o.id = q.prd_order_id LEFT JOIN stl_deduction sd ON sd.id = q.deduction_id LEFT JOIN stl_statement_item si ON si.source_type = 'DEDUCTION' AND si.source_id = q.deduction_id AND si.active LEFT JOIN stl_statement st ON st.id = si.statement_id

SELECT
WHERE q.kind = 'FINAL' AND q.result = 'FAIL' AND q.rework_done_time IS NULL
AND q.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY q.inspect_date, q.id LIMIT 500
mapper.sql: SELECT 'INCOMING' AS kind, d.id AS source_id, d.no AS source_no, d.doc_date AS source_date, d.company_id, d.partner_id, NULL::bigint AS prd_order_id, NULL AS prd_order_kind, NULL AS prd_order_no, NULL AS product_line, t.target_desc, t.lot_qty, t.unit, 1 AS attempt_no FROM inv_doc d JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT left(string_agg(DISTINCT m.name, '、'), 255) AS target_desc, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit)) = 1 THEN SUM(COALESCE(i.purchase_qty, i.qty)) END AS lot_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit)) = 1 THEN MIN(COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit)) END AS unit FROM inv_doc_item i JOIN bas_material_sku k ON k.id = i.material_sku_id JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id WHERE i.doc_id = d.id ) t ON true WHERE d.doc_type = 'PURCHASE_IN' AND d.status = 'APPROVED' AND d.partner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.doc_date >= #{since} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qc_inspection x WHERE x.inv_doc_id = d.id AND x.kind = 'INCOMING') UNION ALL SELECT 'FINAL', r.id, r.no, r.receipt_date, r.company_id, o.factory_id, o.id, o.kind, o.no, o.product_line, left(concat_ws(' ', st.code, st.name), 255), (SELECT SUM(ri.qty) FROM prd_receipt_item ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = r.id), 'PIECE', COALESCE(lq.attempt_no, 0) + 1 FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_order o ON o.id = r.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style st ON st.id = o.style_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.attempt_no, x.rework_done_time FROM qc_inspection x WHERE x.prd_receipt_id = r.id AND x.kind = 'FINAL' ORDER BY x.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1) lq ON true WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND (lq.attempt_no IS NULL AND r.receipt_date >= #{since} OR lq.rework_done_time IS NOT NULL)

SELECT x.*, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, p.code AS partner_code, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name FROM () x JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = x.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = x.partner_id WHERE true
AND (x.product_line IS NULL OR x.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}))
AND x.kind = #{q.kind} AND x.company_id = #{q.companyId}
AND (x.source_no ILIKE #{kw} OR x.prd_order_no ILIKE #{kw} OR x.target_desc ILIKE #{kw} OR p.code ILIKE #{kw} OR p.name LIKE #{kw} OR p.short_name LIKE #{kw})
ORDER BY x.attempt_no DESC, x.source_date DESC, x.source_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () x WHERE true
AND (x.product_line IS NULL OR x.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qc_inspection q WHERE q.kind = 'FINAL' AND q.result = 'FAIL' AND q.rework_time IS NULL

SELECT 'INCOMING' AS kind, d.id AS source_id, d.no AS source_no, d.status AS source_status, d.company_id, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, d.partner_id, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, t.target_desc, t.lot_qty, t.unit FROM inv_doc d JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = d.company_id LEFT JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = d.partner_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT left(string_agg(DISTINCT m.name, '、'), 255) AS target_desc, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit)) = 1 THEN SUM(COALESCE(i.purchase_qty, i.qty)) END AS lot_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit)) = 1 THEN MIN(COALESCE(i.purchase_unit, m.stock_unit)) END AS unit FROM inv_doc_item i JOIN bas_material_sku k ON k.id = i.material_sku_id JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id WHERE i.doc_id = d.id ) t ON true WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.doc_type = 'PURCHASE_IN'

SELECT 'FINAL' AS kind, r.id AS source_id, r.no AS source_no, r.status AS source_status, r.company_id, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, o.factory_id AS partner_id, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, o.id AS prd_order_id, o.kind AS prd_order_kind, o.no AS prd_order_no, o.product_line, left(concat_ws(' ', st.code, st.name), 255) AS target_desc, (SELECT SUM(ri.qty) FROM prd_receipt_item ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = r.id) AS lot_qty, 'PIECE' AS unit FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_order o ON o.id = r.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style st ON st.id = o.style_id JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = r.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = o.factory_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id AS source_id, o.no AS source_no, o.status AS source_status, o.company_id, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, o.factory_id AS partner_id, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, o.id AS prd_order_id, o.kind AS prd_order_kind, o.no AS prd_order_no, o.product_line, left(concat_ws(' ', st.code, st.name), 255) AS target_desc, o.total_qty AS lot_qty, 'PIECE' AS unit FROM prd_order o JOIN sty_style st ON st.id = o.style_id JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = o.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = o.factory_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.no, o.kind, o.status, o.company_id, st.code AS style_code, st.name AS style_name, o.factory_id AS partner_id, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, o.total_qty FROM prd_order o JOIN sty_style st ON st.id = o.style_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = o.factory_id WHERE o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE')
AND o.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler})
AND (o.no ILIKE #{kw} OR st.code ILIKE #{kw} OR st.name LIKE #{kw} OR p.code ILIKE #{kw} OR p.name LIKE #{kw} OR p.short_name LIKE #{kw})
ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT q.partner_id, p.code AS partner_code, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, COUNT(*) AS inspect_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.result = 'PASS') AS pass_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.result = 'CONCESSION') AS concession_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.result = 'FAIL') AS fail_count, SUM(q.sample_qty) AS sample_qty, SUM(q.defect_qty) FILTER (WHERE q.sample_qty IS NOT NULL) AS defect_qty, SUM(sd.amount) AS deduct_amount FROM qc_inspection q JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = q.partner_id LEFT JOIN stl_deduction sd ON sd.id = q.deduction_id
GROUP BY q.partner_id, p.code, p.short_name, p.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.result = 'FAIL') DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, p.code LIMIT 500

SELECT q.partner_id AS "partnerId", t.v AS "defectType", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM qc_inspection q CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(q.defect_types) AS t(v)
GROUP BY q.partner_id, t.v ORDER BY q.partner_id, COUNT(*) DESC, t.v
